t: Nutro Products - Wikipedia
s: October 27, 2025 - The Nutro Company, Inc. is an American manufacturer of pet food. The company, a subsidiary of Mars, Incorporated since 2007, is the developer and manufacturer of the Max, Wholesome Essentials, Ultra, Wild Frontier, and Crave brands of dog and cat food, as well as Greenies dental treats.
